title: Walk-through 1 of 5: camera checks, aimed skill, downer, Arisen fight (any Arisen vocation, about 5 minutes)
intro: Step through with End. Open ground, no enemies near, full party with an Archer pawn in it, controller connected, your current Arisen vocation is fine. Each step tells you what to do and waits for End; a few run by themselves (they say HANDS OFF). If something looks wrong, press Home (saves the last 30 seconds) and carry on.

steps.text: CAMERA 1 of 3. As the Arisen, no enemy near: draw your weapon. The camera should move out to the combat distance. Sheathe again. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

CAMERA 2 of 3. F7 until your ARCHER pawn is selected, F6 to play her. Hold aim for 3 seconds, then let go. The camera should ease back to your distance. The grey line below shows what the camera mod reports. Stay in control of her. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

expect.label: (information) camera mod reports 'suspended' while the Archer pawn aims

steps.text: AIMED SKILL. Still as the Archer pawn, on the CONTROLLER: hold the aim button and press the button of skill 1 (no L1). She should use that skill. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

expect.label: aimed skill fired on the game's aim button

steps.text: Back to the Arisen: F6, or hold D-pad down. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

CAMERA 3 of 3 (co-op bow zoom). With the Archer pawn still selected press Ctrl+F6. On the controller hold aim for 3 seconds: the camera should behave as it always did. Ctrl+F6 again to stop. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

PAWN DOWNER. F7 to select a pawn (do NOT take control). Press Ctrl+F10: she should drop. Pick her up by hand if you like; she is healed in the next step either way. Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)

expect.label: Ctrl+F10 puts the selected pawn down

steps.text: HANDS OFF: taking control of your main pawn
HANDS OFF: three goblins. Watch the Arisen (current vocation) fight on his own.

expect.label: the current vocation Arisen attacks or uses a skill on his own
lock-on stays with the played pawn

steps.text: Did he fight sensibly (moved in, attacked, used skills, did not stand still or run off)? Then press End. (If it looked wrong: press Home first, then End.)
Last step: developer mode is being switched OFF for the next test (player mode). Nothing changes until you Reset Scripts.
steps.each_frame: if not TG_dev_off then TG_dev_off = true; json.dump_file('DPC_dev.json', { dev = false, note = 'switched by a TestGuide walk-through plan' }) end

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.cerrs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.dpc: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.info
probes.sel: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.sel_label
probes.holds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.holds or 0) or 0
probes.poss: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.state.active == true
probes.lock_ok:
local D = _G.DPC_dbg; if not (D and D.state.active and D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl and D.state.pawn_chara) then return nil end
local c = D.state.arisen_lockon_ctrl:get_field('Chara'); return c ~= nil and c:get_address() == D.state.pawn_chara:get_address()
probes.lockfix: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.lock_fixes or 0) or 0
probes.ring:
local gm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.GuiManager'); local u = gm and gm:get_field('MagicBowReticle'); if not u then return false end
return u:call('get_GameObject'):call('get_DrawSelf') == true
probes.shots: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and ((b.presses or 0) + (b.skill_uses or 0)) or 0
probes.skills: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.skill_uses or 0
probes.bmode: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.mode
probes.world: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.world
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.binds: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.bind and D.R.bind.sig
probes.cam: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/CameraDistance.json'); return ok and d and tostring(d.info) or ''
probes.aimsk: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.aim and d.aim.aim_skills or 0
probes.anydead:
local pm = sdk.get_managed_singleton('app.PawnManager'); local l = pm and pm:call('get_PawnCharacterList'); if not l then return false end
for i = 0, l:call('get_Count') - 1 do local c = l:call('get_Item', i); if c and c:call('get_IsDead') == true then return true end end
return false
probes.who: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.state.active and tostring(D.state.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.ajob: local b = H.dpc_brain(); return b and b.job
